  (a + b) / 2 - Real.sqrt (a * b) ≤ (a - b)^2 / (8 * b) := by

  have h₃ : 0 < a := h₀.1

  -- Multiply both sides by 8*b to clear denominators

    -- Expand and rearrange terms to show the inequality holds

      ring
    rw [h₆]
    have h₇ : 4 * b * (a + b) - 8 * b * Real.sqrt (a * b) ≤ (a - b)^2 := by
      -- Use the fact that (sqrt(a) - sqrt(b))^2 >= 0

          _ = a - 2 * Real.sqrt (a * b) + b := by
            rw [Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt h₃), Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt h₂)]
            have h₁₀ : Real.sqrt a * Real.sqrt b = Real.sqrt (a * b) := by
              rw [Real.sqrt_mul (le_of_lt h₃)]
            rw [h₁₀]
          _ = a - 2 * Real.sqrt (a * b) + b := by ring
      have h₁₀ : 0 ≤ a - 2 * Real.sqrt (a * b) + b := by linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b)]
    linarith
  -- Divide by 8*b to get back to original form
  have h₆ : (a + b) / 2 - Real.sqrt (a * b) ≤ (a - b)^2 / (8 * b) := by
    calc
      (a + b) / 2 - Real.sqrt (a * b) = (8 * b * ((a + b) / 2 - Real.sqrt (a * b))) / (8 * b) := by
        field_simp [h₂.ne']
        <;> ring
      _ ≤ (a - b)^2 / (8 * b) := by
        apply (div_le_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
        linarith
